title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 24 FEBRUARY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 23 February 2026 Showery condition over the island is expected to reduce from today (23). Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Southern province and in Rathnapura and Kalutara districts after 2.00 p.m. Mainly fair weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and North-central provinces and in Galle, Matara and Kurunegala districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
